name: Südsteiermark

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Austrian quality wine from approved grape varieties, tested by the state before sale. Prädikatswein and DAC wines sit within it.
Districtus Austriae Controllatus, Austria's rules for regionally typical wines. The wine must show the typical character of its area.

blurb.text: A wine area in Steiermark, Austria, where Sauvignon Blanc is the most planted grape at 26 percent. Welschriesling, Muscat Blanc and Pinot Blanc follow, with Chardonnay also grown.
